unami-handoff.unami/no_question_plain_notes/final:
On 30 May 2023, the Security Council unanimously adopted Resolution 2682 (2023) [S/PV.9331, p. 2], extending UNAMI's mandate to 31 May 2024. The resolution prioritizes inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation with full women's participation. It formally authorizes the mission's continued operational framework under Council authority, supported by Iraq's request [Working Note 1].

The Council also mandated an independent strategic review of UNAMI by 31 March 2024 [Working Note 2]. This review must consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society, and Kuwait. Iraq's government expressed support via a letter dated 18 May 2023 [Working Note 2]. The review will assess threats, mandate relevance, and recommend structural changes to support regional cooperation. The Secretary-General is required to report biannually on UNAMI's fulfilment of responsibilities [Working Note 1]. No national explanations of vote were recorded in this meeting.
